harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «وإن يروا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «انشق القمر»; «سحر» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it".

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «كذَّبوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {يُعْرِضُوا}, and the clause «وكل أمر مستقر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The wāw is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); the preposition «من الأنباء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما»; and the clause «فيه مزدجر» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «حكمة» is a badal (substitute) from {مَا}. The fāʾ is conjunctive; «ما» is negative; «تُغْن» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ, which is omitted in writing following the pronunciation in connected speech, where it is dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters. The clause «فما تغن النذر» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {جَاءَهُمْ}.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «فتولَّ» is resumptive; «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied "remember". «يَدْع» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw, which is omitted in writing; «الداع» is the fāʿil (agent), nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ, which is omitted in writing; the preposition «إلى شيء» is attached to «يدع».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «خُشَّعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يخرجون»; placing the ḥāl before a fully conjugable verb is permissible. «أبصارهم» is the fāʿil of «خشعا». [In such cases] the broken plural is more common than the singular; as for the sound plural, as in «مررت بقوم كريمين آباؤهم» (I passed by people whose fathers are noble), it is interpreted according to the dialect of (أكلوني البراغيث) ("the fleas ate me"). The clause «يخرجون» is resumptive, and the clause «كأنهم جراد» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يخرجون».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «مهطعين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of {يَخْرُجُونَ}; «إلى الداع» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مُهْطعين»; the clause «يقول» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «كذبت» is resumptive, and the clause «فكذَّبوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «كذَّبت». His words «مجنون»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "he is mad", and the clause «وازدجر» is conjoined to the clause (هو مجنون).

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «فدعا» is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition bāʾ; and the clause «فانتصر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «ففتحنا» is resumptive; the preposition «بماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أبواب السماء», i.e. "(We opened them) accompanied by this water".

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «عيونا» is a tamyīz (specification); the clause «فالتقى الماء» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «فجَّرنا»; and the clause «قد قُدِر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أمر».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «وحملناه» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «التقى الماء».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «تجري» is a naʿt (adjective) of {ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ}; the preposition «بأعيننا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تجري»; «جزاء» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition «لمن» is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) «جزاء».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The wāw is resumptive; «آية» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ. «مدَّكر» is mubtadaʾ (subject), «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "so is there anyone who will take heed?" The original form of «مُدَّكِر» is مُذْتَكِر: the dhāl was changed to dāl, then the tāʾ was changed to dāl, then the dāl was assimilated into the dāl.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «نُذُر» is a noun maʿṭūf (conjoined) to «عذابي», nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the omitted yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The wāw is resumptive; «مُدَّكر» is mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The fāʾ in «فكيف» is resumptive; see the i'rab of verse (16).

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The preposition «في يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «تنزع» is a naʿt (adjective) of {رِيحًا}; the clause «كأنهم أعجاز» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الناس».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «فقالوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {كَذَّبَتْ}. «بشرا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned after it; the preposition «منا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «بشرا», and «واحدا» is a naʿt; the clause «نتبعه» is explicative. The clause «إنا لفي ضلال» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and «إذًا» is a particle of response.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «أؤلقي» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the preposition «من بيننا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «عليه».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «سيعلمون» is resumptive; «من» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الكذَّاب» is the khabar (predicate); the clause «مَن الكذَّاب» stands in place of the two objects of «علم», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «فتنة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فتنة»; and the clause «فارتقبهم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «إنَّا مرسلو».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «ونبئهم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «اصطبر»; «أنَّ» and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), stands in place of the second and third objects. «بينهم»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قسمة». The clause «كل شرب محتضر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «فنادوا» is resumptive, and the clause «فتعاطى» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «نادوا».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, and «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «فكانوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أرسلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «مُدَّكر» is mubtadaʾ (subject), «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "there". The clause «فهل من مُدَّكر» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «يَسَّرْنا».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «آل» is excepted, accusative (manṣūb); the clause «نجَّيناهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «نعمة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the preposition «مِنْ عندنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «نعمة». The clause «نجزي» is resumptive, and the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "We recompense him with a recompense like that recompense".

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause «فتماروا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أنذرهم».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: (ولقد راودوه عن ضيفه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أنذرهم»; the clause «فطمسنا» is conjoined to the clause «راودوه», and the clause «فذوقوا» is conjoined to the clause «طمسنا».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «بكرة» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; it is declined as a triptote because it is indefinite; had a specific time been intended by it, it would have been a diptote because of definiteness and the feminine.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «فذوقوا» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {صَبَّحَهُمْ}.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The wāw in «ولقد» is resumptive; «مُدَّكر» is mubtadaʾ (subject) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «فهل من مدَّكر» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «يسَّرنا».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: (ولقد جاء آل فرعون النذر) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw in «ولقد» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «كذَّبوا» is resumptive; the clause «فأخذناهم» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «كذَّبوا»; «أَخْذَ» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «أكفاركم خير» is resumptive; the preposition «من أولئكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خير». The clause «لكم براءة» is resumptive, and «أم» is disconnected (munqaṭiʿa); the preposition «في الزبر» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «براءة».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «يقولون» is resumptive; «جميع» is the khabar (predicate), and «منتصر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جميع».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: (سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «يوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted (تقول), i.e. "the keepers will say on the day"; the clause «ذوقوا» is the maqūl al-qawl (content of the saying) of the implied saying. The preposition «على وجوههم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, and «سقر» is a diptote because it is a proper name and feminine in meaning.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «كلَّ» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb explained by what follows it, and the clause «خلقناه» is explicative; the preposition «بقدر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «خلقناه»; and the implied clause (خلقنا) is the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «وما أمرنا إلا واحدة» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause {إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ}; the preposition «كلمح» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «واحدة»; the preposition «بالبصر» is attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) (لمح).

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The wāw is resumptive, and the clause «فهل من مدَّكر» is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause «أهلكنا».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The preposition «في الزبر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كل»; the clause (وكل شيء في الزبر) is resumptive, and the clause «فعلوه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كل شيء».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: (وكل صغير وكبير مستطر) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the preceding resumptive clause; «مستطر» is the khabar (predicate) of «كل».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The preposition «في مقعد» is a badal (substitute) from {فِي جَنَّاتٍ}; the adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».
